title: WITHIN-DOCUMENT EFFICIENCY + SCORE-PRESERVING OPTIMIZATION
do_nots: do not freeze SYSTEM-E as a release
do not modify SYSTEM-E-WITHIN-DOC.json / SYSTEM-D-GUARD.json / SYSTEM-D-RELEASE.json / cs_v1_control
do not use the four rescue IDs as a selection gate

frozen_identities.parent_source: TOP 10 unique version_ids first-seen in SYSTEM-A fused ranking (typically 6-9, not always 10)

track_1.goal: Remove redundant local-BM25 full-corpus IDF/CTE work without changing SYSTEM-E retrieval behavior.
track_1.method: ONE lexical_search SQL call with version_ids=all parents (same _LEXICAL_SQL, full-corpus IDF), then top-W=20 per parent with ORDER BY round(score::numeric, 9) DESC, chunk_id ASC. Do not reuse SYSTEM-A global top-50 BM25 (RRF overwrites score; local W=20 includes chunks never in A's 50).

equivalence_gate.if_false: STOP. Do not run Track 2. Write mismatch report.

track_2.L_means: ADDITIVE LOCAL PASSAGES PER QUERY after dedupe and excluding A-pool-100. Not per parent.
steps: generate current E local candidates (optimized, equivalent)
take first L additive passages for the entire query
union with A-pool-100, merge RRF, frozen D blend/CE as in E
track_2.merge_rrf_local_lists: filter per-parent local top-W to (in A-pool-100) OR (selected L extras); keep original within-parent BM25 ranks 1..W. Overlap with A does not count toward L.

cross_parent_ordering_frozen.inspected: system_e.local_bm25_per_parent copies lexical_search SearchHit; score is full-corpus-equivalent BM25; rank overwritten 1..W. No existing cross-parent ordering.
cross_parent_ordering_frozen.existing_within_parent_tiebreak: ORDER BY round(scored.score::numeric, 9) DESC, scored.chunk_id  (_LEXICAL_SQL retrieval.py)
cross_parent_ordering_frozen.key: among extras not in A-pool-100, after dedupe: round(local_BM25_score numeric 9) DESC, then chunk_id ASC

selection_rule.select: smallest L in {10,20,40} satisfying both conditions
conditions: zero strict Recall@10 regressions versus SYSTEM-D
selection_rule.if_none_qualify: select none; EXP-018 remains MECHANISM_SUPPORTED; capped variants not promoted
selection_rule.threshold_provenance: >=44/50 was preregistered for EXP-018B after observing EXP-018's development result of 45/50. Development-stage criterion, not an independent validation threshold.

known_rescue_ids_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY.note: V2D-48 was already in D pool (11→7); not a pool rescue.
